mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, which may lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, thereby driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns despite low unemployment rates in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% may indicate monetary tightening, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite high FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in both GDP and retail sales signals strong economic demand, which may lead to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns despite positive GDP and retail sales growth in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP growth during a monetary tightening cycle may indicate reduced consumer and business spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns despite declining GDP growth in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals increased economic activity, which may lead to higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns despite rising industrial production in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in payroll employment growth may indicate economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite slow payroll growth.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rates combined with rising consumer price inflation may signal a restrictive monetary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns despite high FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL in > 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts may indicate reduced consumer demand and economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns despite low housing starts in > 40% of cases.
